answer: Sortition audit duty makes every identity work. Each epoch the network drafts some identities to re-check attestations; each is handed cases it cannot copy, scattered in a grove. Evidence is due before the window closes: miss it and stake is slashed. Rubber-stamping fails: planted bad cases are mixed in, and approving one burns the auditor's stake. A farm of a hundred puppets is drafted a hundred times as often, so its load climbs with no bulk discount; an honest agent pays one short shift. In the tundra of fakes, one whisper of real work separates a living identity from a frozen shell.
